selection_order: highest source-course macro AP among recall ties
lift_definition: Compute precision / observed positive prevalence within each cohort, then average cohorts within courses and courses equally. The denominator is expected random-selection precision, not one realized random ranking.
tp_definition: Sum true-positive enrollment-record counts within each seed; never infer counts from macro recall or sum repeated seeds as unique records.
ap_definition: Average precision from continuous candidate scores within each cohort; undefined for no-positive cohorts, otherwise average cohorts within courses and courses equally. Not trapezoidal PR area or AP of binary masks.
scope: Exploratory source-only metric refinement on previously inspected populations, not independent external confirmation.
